newsitem.title: USA: Brazil coffee weather remains favorable -- WSC.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee weather remains favorable -- WSC.

text.p: Favorable weather conditions for Brazil's coffee trees and the maturing crop should continue with no cold weather threat in sight, Weather Servces Corp said in an update on Friday.
The latest indications are that cold air will move across southern Argentina next week but remain well to the south of the Brazilian coffee belt, it said.
On Friday, the coffee belt had partly to mostly cloudy skies with scattered light showers. Temperatures averaged below normal with lows on Friday morning from 52-59 Fahrenheit (11-15 C).

WSC said skies should clear later Friday with a lingering shower in the belt, followed by partly cloudy skies Saturday and Sunday with an isolated shower. Temperatures will continue to average near to below normal with lows in the 50s F (teens C).

Conditions should be partly cloudy on Monday and Tuesday, with variable clouds Wednesday and Thursday an a chance of a few light showers developing, WSC said. Temperatures should average near normal levels. There is no cold weather in sight, it said.
